items.summary: Remove the anchor element and its child SVG icon identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] and /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1]/svg[1] from the Header component. These are located in the third div group of the header's first div, and both the link wrapper and the SVG inside it must be completely removed.

Remove the 'Call Now' button or link from the Header component (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx). This is the element labeled 'Call Now' visible in the top/header area of the page. It must be completely removed from the header markup.
